part1.title: Introduction and Interview
part1.instructions: I'd like to ask you about your hobbies and free time activities.
questions: What do you like to do in your free time?
Do you have any hobbies?
How often do you do your hobby?
Do you prefer indoor or outdoor activities?
Did you have the same hobbies when you were a child?

part2.title: Individual Long Turn
part2.duration: 3-4 minutes total (1 min prep + 2 min speaking)

cueCard.title: Describe a hobby or activity you really enjoy
points: And explain why you enjoy it so much
cueCard.notes: You will have 1 minute to prepare and 1-2 minutes to speak.

part3.title: Two-way Discussion
part3.instructions: Now let's discuss hobbies and leisure activities in general.
questions: Why do you think people need hobbies?
Are there any hobbies that are popular in your country?
Do you think expensive hobbies are better than cheap ones?
How have people's leisure activities changed over time?
Should children be encouraged to have hobbies?

modelAnswer.part2: I'd like to talk about reading, which is a hobby I really enjoy. I started reading books when I was about ten years old. My teacher at school encouraged us to read more, and I discovered that I really liked stories about adventure and friendship. Now I try to read for at least thirty minutes every day, usually before I go to bed. On weekends, I sometimes spend two or three hours reading because I have more free time. I enjoy reading so much because it helps me relax after a busy day. When I read, I can forget about my problems and enter into different worlds and meet interesting characters. Reading also helps me learn new words and improve my language skills. I like many different types of books, but I especially enjoy mystery novels and stories about travel. Reading is not expensive, and I can do it anywhere - at home, in the park, or even on the bus.

part1.title: Introduction and Interview
part1.instructions: Let's talk about your hometown and places you've visited.
questions: Can you describe your hometown?
What do you like about living there?
Is there anything you don't like about your hometown?
Have you ever traveled to other places?
Where would you like to visit in the future?

part2.title: Individual Long Turn
part2.duration: 3-4 minutes total (1 min prep + 2 min speaking)
part2.topic: Describe a place you would like to visit

cueCard.title: Describe a place you would like to visit
points: And explain why you want to visit this place
cueCard.notes: You will have 1 minute to prepare and 1-2 minutes to speak.

part3.title: Two-way Discussion
part3.instructions: Let's discuss travel and tourism in general.
questions: Why do people like to travel?
What are the benefits of visiting other countries?
Do you think tourism is good for a country?
How has travel changed compared to the past?
What problems can tourism cause?
